Collections intro.paragraph: Twelve curated collections covering front of house, back of house and every service moment in between.

style.Collections: background-color: var(--on-cream); align-items: center; gap: 64px; @media(--mobile){ gap: 40px; }
style.Collections head: flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 22px; padding: 0px; max-width: 820px;
style.Collection grid: padding: 0px; gap: 20px; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); grid-template-rows: repeat(3, auto); @media(--tablet){ grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); grid-template-rows: repeat(4, auto); } @media(--mobile){ grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); grid-template-rows: repeat(6, auto); gap: 12px; }
style.Tile Chinaware: flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-start; height: 380px; padding: 26px 28px 27px 28px; overflow: hidden; background-image: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(7,31,68,0) 35%, rgba(7,31,68,0.92) 100%), url(https://soharon.co.uk/onora/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/home-tile-chinaware.jpg); background-size: cover; background-position: center center; background-repeat: no-repeat; transition: opacity 0.3s; &:hover{ opacity: 0.92; } @media(--tablet){ height: 340px; } @media(--mobile){ height: 230px; padding: 14px 14px 16px 14px; }
style.Tile Chinaware number: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 2px; color: var(--on-gold-soft);
style.Tile Chinaware title: font-family: var(--on-serif); font-weight: 600; font-size: 32px; line-height: 34px; letter-spacing: -0.3px; color: #FFFFFF; @media(--mobile){ font-size: 22px; line-height: 24px; }
style.Tile Chinaware link: font-family: var(--on-sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 1.6px; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.85); @media(--mobile){ font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 1px; }
